name: orbit-website-builder
description: Orbit - self-hosted SaaS website builder with AI-simulated generation, subdomain hosting and DNS mapping

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
